title: TRDP: Fix printf formatting with 32-bit time_t
description:
Explicitly cast time_t to intmax_t for printing, to avoid warnings and
errors on systems with 32-bit time_t.

Prefer C standard printf formats to GLib ones.

Avoid using long unless necessary, e.g. when required by some standard
API; it's not the same size on different platforms, and an nstime_t nsecs
is an int.

Ping #21297

AI-Assisted: no
